# dsh-preview-market
A **vertical preview market** for DeepSeek Harness. A top-level settings section (and a Settings → P
lugins tab) lists the preview plugins that exist for DSH, shows which ones the active profile alread
y has, and hands installs/updates to dsh-market or the official `dsh plugin` command.
It is not a general plugin market, and it does not implement previews itself: every preview plugin s
tays an independent Loader entry with its own repository, version and settings. The market only prov
ides the catalog, the installed view and the entry points.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Open **Settings → Preview market** (the same panel is also under **Settings → Plugins**).
Upgrading from `dsh-media-preview` / `dsh-blend-preview` / `dsh-stl-preview`? See MIGRATION.md.
## What it does

- **Catalog** — first-party preview plugins with their formats, host requirements and versions.
- **
Installed view** — reads the active profile's `package.json`, matching catalog names by default and

honouring a package's `dsh.preview` manifest when present; never imports child plugin code.
- **Inst
all / update** — delegates to `dsh-market` when it is present. Without it, the card shows the exact

`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <package>@<version>` command to copy.
- **Independent plugins**
— media, Blender and STL remain separate packages; this page has no renderer and does not merge thei
, Blender and STL remain separate packages; this page has no renderer and does not merge their code.

## Current preview plugins
| Plugin | Opens | Formats | Host requirement |

| `dsh-preview-media` | Video and audio | mp4/mov/webm/mkv + mp3/flac/wav/… | — |
| `dsh-preview-ble

nder` | Blender scenes | `.blend` | Blender 3.6+ |
| `dsh-preview-stl` | STL meshes | `.stl` | — |
|
`dsh-preview-snip` | Tool: circle a region or quote text | no file extension | — |
### dsh-preview-media
Play video/audio in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range ro
ute. Desktop seeking uses the token-guarded loopback origin; `0.1.5` also retries the authenticated
route when the loopback reports a code-4 media error.
### dsh-preview-blender
A `.blend` file is exported to a cached GLB by Blender headless, then rendered in a dependency-free
WebGL viewport with scene statistics.
### dsh-preview-stl
STL is parsed in the browser; the viewport reports size, volume, surface area and watertightness wit
hout uploading the mesh.
### dsh-preview-snip
A preview-header tool: drag a rectangle over an image/PDF to attach a PNG, or quote selected text in
tool: drag a rectangle over an image/PDF to attach a PNG, or quote selected text into the composer.
## Catalog (0.1.10)
Every plugin is **one file** under `catalog/plugins/`, named `<owner>__<repo>.json`. A third-party s
ubmission adds exactly one file plus the regenerated `catalog.json` snapshot — no market code change
. The Host loads, validates and merges all files at startup; the format and PR steps are in `catalog
oads, validates and merges all files at startup; the format and PR steps are in `catalog/README.md`.
Preview entries use `kind: "media"` or `"three"` and declare their extensions; `dsh-preview-snip` us
es `kind: "tool"`, which has no file extensions and is displayed as a tool card.
## Configuration
Settings → Plugins → Preview market (namespace `preview-market`):
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `enabled` | `true` | Register the routes, the top-level section and the Settings → Plugins tab. |

| `routeRoot` | `/api/preview-market` | Authenticated route root; must stay under `/api`. |
| `profi
leDir` | `""` | Profile to inspect. Empty uses the Host `profileContext`, then `$DSH_HOME/profiles/d

esktop`. |
| `debug` | `false` | Reserved for request diagnostics. |
## Examples
- `examples/profile-overrides.yml` — a safe starting point for per-profile overrides (media chunk si

ze, Blender path, STL unit scale).
- `catalog.json` — machine-readable snapshot of the shipped catal
og, enforced by a unit test.

## Status
`0.1.10` — top-level Settings → Preview market section with Discover / Installed tabs, plus the Sett
ings → Plugins tab. The catalog is one file per plugin under `catalog/plugins/` (preview plugins and
tool entries such as the preview snip), so third-party entries are a one-file PR. Enable/disable go
es through dsh-market. One-click install requires the package in the connected dsh-market registry;
otherwise use the copyable command. Configuration stays in each child plugin's own Settings → Plugin
